explanation: Sums the actual threshold-sensitive scan recurrence into its uniform ledger budget. The recurrence charges expensive traversal only before threshold overflow, while the wanted-count and threshold budgets control the total.
theorem_title: A guarded prefix recurrence fits the dispatch budget
theorem_formal_statement:
theorem ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.SharedTraversalCosts.prefix_time_le_dispatch_budget {time mass : ℕ → ℕ} {c n k threshold count : ℕ}
    (hzero : time 0 ≤ 30)
    (hstep : ∀ i, time (i+1) ≤ time i+(_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.SharedTraversalCosts.scaledOverhead n*_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.CostLedger.queryTerms n 0+_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.SharedTraversalCosts.scalarOverhead c n)+
      if threshold < _root_.ThreeSum.SharedTraversalCosts.prefixMass mass i+mass i then 0 else
        mass i*(_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.SharedTraversalCosts.scaledOverhead n*(_root_.ThreeSum.CostLedger.microPartitions n*_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.CostLedger.allQueryTerms n+_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.StageBounds.terminalChoices n)))
    (hcount : count ≤ _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.UniformStageBounds.wantedBudget n)
    (hthreshold : threshold ≤ _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.UniformStageBounds.falseBudget k n*_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.TrimScales.representationBound n) :
    time count ≤ _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.SharedTraversalCosts.dispatchBudget c k n := by sorry
theorem_natural_language_statement:
Let $T,m:\mathbb N\to\mathbb N$ be accumulated time and per-slot mass. Suppose $T(0)\le30$ and every increment is bounded by the specified query/scalar overhead plus the mass-weighted traversal charge only when the running prefix mass remains within threshold $q$. If the processed count is at most the uniform wanted budget and $q$ is at most the uniform false budget times the representation bound, then $$T(\mathrm{count})\le\operatorname{dispatchBudget}(c,k,n),$$ for the natural scalar overhead parameter $c$, magnitude exponent $k$, and size $n$.

Sums the actual threshold-sensitive scan recurrence into its uniform ledger budget. This supports the complete deterministic integer 3SUM runtime proof.
